answer: The willow schedule is applied in hollow and canyon makes public each instalment. A payout is split so that 54% arrives at settlement and the rest over 4 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3826 identities would post 3872 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
